title: Midwest Aerospace Group announces new online blade repair pricing calculator
summary: The new calculator provides operators, maintenance teams, and fleet managers with immediate access to estimated blade repair pricing.
body_markdown:
Midwest Aerospace Group has announced the launch of a new online Blade Repair Pricing Calculator, developed to make estimating helicopter main and tail rotor blade repair costs faster, easier, and more transparent.


Available through Midwest Blade Tech and Rotorcraft Repair & Manufacturing, the new calculator provides operators, maintenance teams, and fleet managers with immediate access to estimated blade repair pricing, reducing the time and back-and-forth traditionally associated with requesting repair quotes.


To celebrate the launch, both companies are offering 10% off blade repair services to the first 50 customers who use the new calculator to place an order.


“Transparency and customer service are at the center of everything we do,” said Joseph L. Giannini, vice president of Midwest Aerospace.


“Our goal is to give customers the information they need to make confident maintenance decisions. By making blade repair pricing more accessible, we’re simplifying the process and creating a better experience for the operators who rely on us.”


**Simplifying the Blade** **Repair Process**


The online calculator allows customers to select their aircraft and blade type, choose the appropriate repair or coating service, and receive an instant estimate based on their specific requirements.


Customers can also include multiple blade types in a single estimate, making it easier to plan maintenance across their aircraft or fleet.


Designed with convenience and transparency in mind, the calculator provides an efficient starting point for budgeting, comparing service options, and preparing for upcoming maintenance needs. Final pricing and availability are confirmed following blade inspection.


“For operators, understanding repair costs upfront can make a significant difference in how they plan and manage maintenance,” said Seth Hardage, founder of Rotorcraft Repair & Manufacturing.


“We developed this calculator to remove some of the uncertainty from the process. Customers can now explore their options, see estimated pricing, and move forward with a clearer understanding of what to expect.”


**Competitive Pricing and** **a Commitment to** **Customer** **Value**


In addition to providing greater pricing visibility, Rotorcraft Repair & Manufacturing is reinforcing its commitment to competitive pricing by offering to match or even beat qualifying competitor quotes.


To celebrate the launch, the company is also extending a 10% discount on qualifying blade repair services to the first 50 customers who use the calculator and submit their blades for service.


The calculator reflects a continued commitment to improving the customer experience through accessible information, efficient processes, and dependable rotorcraft blade repair solutions.


**Customers can** **access the Blade** **Repair Pricing Calculator at:**


[https://www.midwestbladetech.com/MBTEstimator](https://www.midwestbladetech.com/MBTEstimator)


**Or**


[https://estimates.rotorcraft.biz](https://estimates.rotorcraft.biz/)


*This press release was prepared and distributed by Midwest Aerospace Company.*
